summary: Adds a thumbnail helper that shells out to ImageMagick convert, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates an arithmetic expression from the query string. It also adds a documentation URL constant to settings.

findings.title: Request query text evaluated as JavaScript
findings.description: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight to eval. The added suppression comments hide this from review tooling. Any caller of /calc can run arbitrary code inside the server process. That caller can read secrets, files and data, or take over the host. Replace eval with a restricted arithmetic parser such as expr-eval or mathjs evaluate in a limited scope. Remove both suppression comments.

findings.consequence: Any caller of /calc can run arbitrary code inside the server process. That caller can read secrets, files and data, or take over the host.
findings.fix: Replace eval with a restricted arithmetic parser such as expr-eval or mathjs evaluate in a limited scope. Remove both suppression comments.

findings.title: Upload name interpolated into a shell command
findings.description: make_thumbnail builds a shell string from upload_name, which comes from the upload form. It runs that string with shell=True, and a nosec comment hides it. An uploader can use a name like a.png;rm -rf ~ to run arbitrary commands as the service user. Pass an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True. Remove the nosec comment.

findings.fix: Pass an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True. Remove the nosec comment.

findings.title: Upload name allows path traversal
findings.description: make_thumbnail joins upload_name from the form into the input and output paths without validation. A name containing ../ escapes UPLOAD_DIR and THUMB_DIR. An uploader can make convert read files outside the upload folder. The uploader can also overwrite files outside the thumbnail folder. Reduce upload_name to its basename with os.path.basename. Reject names that differ or start with a dash.

findings.fix: Reduce upload_name to its basename with os.path.basename. Reject names that differ or start with a dash.

findings.title: New behaviour has no covering test
findings.description: This change adds make_thumbnail and the /calc endpoint. The repository has no test that exercises either one. Regressions and unsafe input handling in these paths go unnoticed. Add tests for make_thumbnail and /calc. Include hostile names and expressions.

candidate.message: This change adds # noqa, which stops ruff reporting what it covers; check that it hides no real problem

dropped.reason: The noqa comment only silences the line-length check on a long documentation URL constant. It hides no real problem.

candidate.message: This change adds # nosec, which stops bandit reporting what it covers; check that it hides no real problem

dropped.reason: The nosec comment hides the shell injection that the finding for c1 already reports on this line. That is one problem, so it gets one finding.

candidate.message: This change adds eslint-disable-next-line, which stops oxlint reporting what it covers; check that it hides no real problem

dropped.reason: The eslint-disable comment hides the eval that the finding for c5 already reports. That is one problem, so it gets one finding.

candidate.message: B404: Consider possible security implications associated with the subprocess module.

dropped.reason: Importing subprocess is not a risk on its own. The unsafe shell=True call is reported under c1.
